identity.project_description: Generates parametric widgets from a spec file.

mission.product_vision: WidgetForge turns a single spec file into a full set of manufacturable parametric widget designs, cutting CAD iteration time from days to minutes.
mission.why_now: Our CAD engineers are re-drafting near-identical widget variants by hand every week, and the manual process is the top complaint in engineering retros.
mission.guiding_principles: Never ship a design the physics engine hasn't validated. Prefer boring, provable geometry over clever-but-fragile parametric tricks.
